description: A company commander must publish a two-day collective sustainment-training schedule for four platoons, assigning each platoon a training lane and one of four reserved blocks while recording the support confirmations needed before execution.

shared_context.S1: Alpha, Bravo, Charlie, and Delta Platoons each require one collective sustainment-training lane during the company's two-day readiness cycle.
shared_context.S2: The four available training blocks are Tuesday 0800, Tuesday 1300, Wednesday 0900, and Wednesday 1000.
shared_context.S3: The four training lanes are fuel-accountability, vehicle-dispatch, communications-procedure, and medical-logistics.
shared_context.S4: Each platoon may attend only one lane, and each lane may be used by only one platoon during this cycle.
shared_context.S5: Capt. Morgan publishes the final schedule, and the company normally holds a readiness synchronization meeting in which the training, motor transport, signal, and medical logistics leads confirm support requirements before the schedule is issued.
shared_context.S6: The routine meeting closeout does not occur until each support lead has made a formal update; a general conversational mention does not substitute for that update.

PF1.text: The company training roster shows that Alpha Platoon is the only platoon whose fuel-accountability evaluator is currently certified, so Alpha must take the fuel-accountability lane at Tuesday 0800; SFC Patel confirmed the roster this morning, but the certification update has not yet been entered on the company training slide.

PF2.text: The vehicle-dispatch trainer is committed to another unit until Wednesday 1000, so Bravo Platoon must take the vehicle-dispatch lane at Wednesday 1000; WO1 Greene received the confirmed motor-pool availability notice this morning, but the notice has not yet been added to the rotation calendar.

PF3.text: The communications practical requires a frequency-load package that will be delivered and validated at Tuesday 1300, so Charlie Platoon must take the communications-procedure lane at Tuesday 1300; Sgt. First Class Alvarez received the signal shop confirmation today, but it is still pending entry in the training schedule.

PF4.text: The temperature-controlled training kit is reserved for Delta Platoon at Wednesday 0900 for the medical-logistics lane; 1LT Brooks confirmed the reservation with the medical warehouse this morning, but the kit handoff is not yet recorded on the company readiness board.

acceptance_conditions: Alpha Platoon must be assigned the fuel-accountability lane at Tuesday 0800.
Bravo Platoon must be assigned the vehicle-dispatch lane at Wednesday 1000.
Charlie Platoon must be assigned the communications-procedure lane at Tuesday 1300.
Delta Platoon must be assigned the medical-logistics lane at Wednesday 0900.
The schedule must include a commitment linked to PF1 whose action or detail references Alpha's evaluator certification or certification update.
The schedule must include a commitment linked to PF2 whose action or detail references motor-pool availability or vehicle-dispatch trainer availability for Bravo Platoon.
The schedule must include a commitment linked to PF3 whose action or detail references the frequency-load package or signal shop confirmation for Charlie Platoon.
The schedule must include a commitment linked to PF4 whose action or detail references the medical kit, medical warehouse reservation, or temperature-controlled training kit for Delta Platoon.
The signal confirmation fact must be cited by the decision-maker.

content_checks.C5: any(c.get('fact_id') == 'PF1' and (('evaluator' in c.get('action', '') and ('certification' in c.get('action', '') or 'certified' in c.get('action', ''))) or ('evaluator' in c.get('detail', '') and ('certification' in c.get('detail', '') or 'certified' in c.get('detail', '')))) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c.get('fact_id') == 'PF2' and (('motor-pool' in c.get('action', '') or 'motor-pool' in c.get('detail', '')) or ('trainer' in c.get('action', '') and 'availability' in c.get('action', '')) or ('trainer' in c.get('detail', '') and 'availability' in c.get('detail', '')) or 'vehicle-dispatch' in c.get('action', '') or 'vehicle-dispatch' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c.get('fact_id') == 'PF3' and ((('frequency' in c.get('action', '') or 'frequency' in c.get('detail', '')) and ('package' in c.get('action', '') or 'package' in c.get('detail', ''))) or (('signal shop' in c.get('action', '') or 'signal shop' in c.get('detail', '')) and ('confirmation' in c.get('action', '') or 'confirmation' in c.get('detail', '')))) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c.get('fact_id') == 'PF4' and (('medical' in c.get('action', '') or 'medical' in c.get('detail', '')) and ('kit' in c.get('action', '') or 'kit' in c.get('detail', '') or 'warehouse' in c.get('action', '') or 'warehouse' in c.get('detail', '') or 'reservation' in c.get('action', '') or 'reservation' in c.get('detail', '') or 'temperature-controlled' in c.get('action', '') or 'temperature-controlled' in c.get('detail', ''))) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The evaluator certification roster changes Alpha's lane and block to fuel-accountability at Tuesday 0800 and requires a commitment referencing the evaluator certification update.
The trainer's availability changes Bravo's lane and block to vehicle-dispatch at Wednesday 1000 and requires a commitment referencing motor-pool or trainer availability.

The frequency-load delivery time changes Charlie's lane and block to communications-procedure at Tuesday 1300, requires a commitment referencing the frequency-load package or signal shop confirmation, and supplies the fact that must be cited.
The medical warehouse reservation changes Delta's lane and block to medical-logistics at Wednesday 0900 and requires a commitment referencing the medical or temperature-controlled training kit.
